description: This file defines an Angular component named BoardComponent for rendering a Tic Tac Toe game board, handling move logic, resetting the game, and determining the winner.

classes.name: BoardComponent
classes.description: An Angular component managing the Tic Tac Toe game board, move tracking, winner checking, and emitting game end events.

methods.name: cellClick
methods.description: Handles a cell being clicked; updates board state, checks for a winner or draw, and switches players.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board to the initial empty state, resets move count, current player, and game over status.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Private method that checks if the current player has achieved a winning combination on the board.

ctags.name: gameEnd
ctags.pattern: /^  @Output() gameEnd = new EventEmitter<{ winner: string | null, draw: boolean }>();$/

fields.name: @Output() gameEnd = new EventEmitter<{ winner: string | null, draw: boolean }>();
